bead.title: Preserve hybrid-async unproven release-lane status in perf evidence
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The performance evidence must continue to state that release-lane hybrid-async hot-path performance is not proven while still requiring future evidence for async lag, replay-contract, ordered batching, high-water, lineage, and retention-frontier fields.

ROOT CAUSE: `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md:91` through `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md:103` define release gate requirements and async evidence fields, while `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md:137` states that hybrid performance cannot be cited until the release-lane hot-path regression is fixed and rerun. The artifact must be tightened without overwriting those existing evidence results.

PROPOSED FIX: Update governing artifact `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md` to preserve the current unproven release-lane hybrid hot-path status and clarify that future `objectlog/hybrid-async` evidence must include async SQLite lag, unknown-outcome replay contract, ordered batching, high-water, lineage, retention-frontier, and release-lane performance fields before it can be cited as release evidence.

NON-SCOPE: Code changes; implementing metrics, repair tools, or performance tests; changing existing evidence results; changes outside the four governing artifact references; altering existing dependency ID `pqueue-b207e65d`; weakening the required verification commands; editing `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md` except as a separate child bead.

DEPENDENCY: parent `pqueue-b207e65d`.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestHybridAsyncPerfEvidencePreserved: `rg -n 'does \*\*not\*\* prove|release-lane|hot path|hybrid performance|hybrid-async|async SQLite lag|replay contract|ordered batching|sqlite_high_water|lineage|retention_frontier' docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md` succeeds so the existing unproven release-lane status is not overwritten and all future async evidence fields remain required.
2. TestHybridAsyncPerfEvidenceNoPlanMutation: `git diff --name-only` after the bead contains only `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md`.
3. TestHybridAsyncPerfEvidenceCargoGate: `cargo test -p pqueue-release ledger_path_honors_env_override_and_default` passes.
4. TestHybridAsyncPerfEvidenceFmtGate: `cargo fmt --check` passes.
5. TestHybridAsyncPerfEvidenceGoGate: `go test ./...` passes or records a no-Go-module skip with the exact command output.
6. TestHybridAsyncPerfEvidenceLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
